verses.en: These also are the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day that the LORD spake with Moses in mount Sinai.
verses.pt: Estas, pois, eram as gerações de Arão e de Moisés, no dia em que o Senhor falou com Moisés no monte Sinai.
verses.en_web: Now this is the history of the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day that Yahweh spoke with Moses in Mount Sinai.
verses.en_bbe: Now these are the generations of Aaron and Moses, in the day when the word of the Lord came to Moses on Mount Sinai.

verses.en: And these are the names of the sons of Aaron; Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.pt: Os nomes dos filhos de Arão são estes: o primogênito, Nadabe; depois Abiú, Eleazar e Itamar.
verses.en_web: These are the names of the sons of Aaron: Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.en_bbe: These are the names of the sons of Aaron: Nadab the oldest, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

verses.en: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests which were anointed, whom he consecrated to minister in the priest’s office.
verses.pt: São esses os nomes dos filhos de Arão, dos sacerdotes que foram ungidos, a quem ele consagrou para administrarem o sacerdocio.
verses.en_web: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests who were anointed, whom he consecrated to minister in the priest’s office.
verses.en_bbe: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests, on whom the holy oil was put, who were marked out as priests.

verses.en: And Nadab and Abihu died before the LORD, when they offered strange fire before the LORD, in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no children: and Eleazar and Ithamar ministered in the priest’s office in the sight of Aaron their father.
verses.pt: Mas Nadabe e Abiú morreram perante o Senhor, quando ofereceram fogo estranho perante o Senhor no deserto de Sinai, e não tiveram filhos; porém Eleazar e Itamar administraram o sacerdócio diante de Arão, seu pai.
verses.en_web: Nadab and Abihu died before Yahweh, when they offered strange fire before Yahweh, in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no children. Eleazar and Ithamar ministered in the priest’s office in the presence of Aaron their father.
verses.en_bbe: And Nadab and Abihu were put to death before the Lord when they made an offering of strange fire before the Lord, in the waste land of Sinai, and they had no children: and Eleazar and Ithamar did the work of priests before Aaron their father.

verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.pt: Então disse o Senhor a Moisés:
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses,

verses.en: Bring the tribe of Levi near, and present them before Aaron the priest, that they may minister unto him.
verses.pt: Faze chegar a tribo de Levi, e põe-nos diante de Arão, o sacerdote, para que o sirvam;
verses.en_web: “Bring the tribe of Levi near, and set them before Aaron the priest, that they may minister to him.
verses.en_bbe: Make the tribe of Levi come near, and put them before Aaron the priest, to be his helpers,

verses.en: And they shall keep his charge, and the charge of the whole congregation before the tabernacle of the congregation, to do the service of the tabernacle.
verses.pt: eles cumprirão o que é devido a ele e a toda a congregação, diante da tenda da revelação, fazendo o serviço do tabernáculo;
verses.en_web: They shall keep his requirements, and the requirements of the whole congregation before the Tent of Meeting, to do the service of the tabernacle.
verses.en_bbe: In order that they may be responsible to him and to all Israel for the care of the Tent of meeting, and to do the work of the House;

verses.en: And they shall keep all the instruments of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the children of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle.
verses.pt: cuidarão de todos os móveis da tenda da revelação, e zelarão pelo cumprimento dos deveres dos filhos de Israel, fazendo o serviço do tabernáculo.
verses.en_web: They shall keep all the furnishings of the Tent of Meeting, and the obligations of the children of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle.
verses.en_bbe: And they will have the care of all the vessels of the Tent of meeting, and will do for the children of Israel all the necessary work of the House.

verses.en: And thou shalt give the Levites unto Aaron and to his sons: they are wholly given unto him out of the children of Israel.
verses.pt: Darás, pois, os levitas a Arão e a seus filhos; de todo lhes são dados da parte dos filhos de Israel.
verses.en_web: You shall give the Levites to Aaron and to his sons. They are wholly given to him on the behalf of the children of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: Give the Levites to Aaron and his sons; so that they may be his without question from among the children of Israel.

verses.en: And thou shalt appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall wait on their priest’s office: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
verses.pt: Mas a Arão e a seus filhos ordenarás que desempenhem o seu sacerdócio; e o estranho que se chegar será morto.
verses.en_web: You shall appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall keep their priesthood. The stranger who comes near shall be put to death.”
verses.en_bbe: And give orders that Aaron and his sons are to keep their place as priests; any strange person who comes near is to be put to death.

verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.pt: Disse mais o senhor a Moisés:
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses,

verses.en: And I, behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel instead of all the firstborn that openeth the matrix among the children of Israel: therefore the Levites shall be mine;
verses.pt: Eu, eu mesmo tenho tomado os levitas do meio dos filhos de Israel, em lugar de todo primogênito, que abre a madre, entre os filhos de Israel; e os levitas serão meus,
verses.en_web: “Behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel instead of all the firstborn who open the womb among the children of Israel; and the Levites shall be mine:
verses.en_bbe: See, I have taken the Levites out of the children of Israel to be mine in place of the first sons of the children of Israel;

verses.en: Because all the firstborn are mine; for on the day that I smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I hallowed unto me all the firstborn in Israel, both man and beast: mine shall they be: I am the LORD.
verses.pt: porque todos os primogênitos são meus. No dia em que feri a todos os primogênitos na terra do Egito, santifiquei para mim todos os primogênitos em Israel, tanto dos homens como dos animais; meus serão. Eu sou o Senhor.
verses.en_web: for all the firstborn are mine. On the day that I struck down all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I made holy to me all the firstborn in Israel, both man and animal. They shall be mine. I am Yahweh.”
verses.en_bbe: For all the first sons are mine; on the day when I put to death all the first sons in the land of Egypt, I took for myself every first male birth of man and beast. They are mine; I am the Lord.

verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,
verses.pt: Disse mais o Senhor a Moisés no deserto de Sinai:
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses in the waste land of Sinai,

verses.en: Number the children of Levi after the house of their fathers, by their families: every male from a month old and upward shalt thou number them.
verses.pt: Conta os filhos de Levi, segundo as casas de seus pais, pelas suas famílias; contarás todo homem da idade de um mês, para cima.
verses.en_web: “Count the children of Levi by their fathers’ houses, by their families. You shall count every male from a month old and upward.”
verses.en_bbe: Let all the children of Levi be numbered by their families and their fathers' houses; let every male of a month old and over be numbered.

verses.en: And Moses numbered them according to the word of the LORD, as he was commanded.
verses.pt: E Moisés os contou conforme o mandado do Senhor, como lhe fora ordenado.
verses.en_web: Moses counted them according to Yahweh’s word, as he was commanded.
verses.en_bbe: So Moses did as the Lord said, numbering them as he had been ordered.

verses.en: And these were the sons of Levi by their names; Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari.
verses.pt: Estes, pois, foram os filhos de Levi, pelos seus nomes: Gérson, Coate e Merári.
verses.en_web: These were the sons of Levi by their names: Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari.
verses.en_bbe: These were the sons of Levi by name: Gershon and Kohath and Merari.

verses.en: And these are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families; Libni, and Shimei.
verses.pt: E estes são os nomes dos filhos de Gérson pelas suas famílias: Líbni e Simei.
verses.en_web: These are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families: Libni and Shimei.
verses.en_bbe: And these are the names of the sons of Gershon, by their families: Libni and Shimei.

verses.en: And the sons of Kohath by their families; Amram, and Izehar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.pt: E os filhos de Coate, pelas suas famílias: Anrão, Izar, Hebrom e Uziel.
verses.en_web: The sons of Kohath by their families: Amram, and Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Kohath, by their families: Amram and Izhar and Hebron and Uzziel.

verses.en: And the sons of Merari by their families; Mahli, and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to the house of their fathers.
verses.pt: E os filhos de Merári, pelas suas familias: Mali e Musi. São essas as famílias dos levitas, segundo as casas de seus pais.
verses.en_web: The sons of Merari by their families: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’ houses.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of Merari by their families: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites in the order of their fathers' houses.

verses.en: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimites: these are the families of the Gershonites.
verses.pt: De Gérson era a familia dos libnitas e a família dos simeítas. São estas as famílias dos gersonitas.
verses.en_web: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimeites: these are the families of the Gershonites.
verses.en_bbe: From Gershon come the Libnites and the Shimeites; these are the families of the Gershonites.

verses.en: Those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, even those that were numbered of them were seven thousand and five hundred.
verses.pt: Os que deles foram contados, segundo o número de todos os homens da idade de um mês para cima, sim, os que deles foram c contados eram sete mil e quinhentos.
verses.en_web: Those who were counted of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, even those who were counted of them were seven thousand five hundred.
verses.en_bbe: Those who were numbered of them, the males from one month old and over, were seven thousand, five hundred.

verses.en: The families of the Gershonites shall pitch behind the tabernacle westward.
verses.pt: As famílias dos gersonitas acampar-se-ão atrás do tabernáculo, ao ocidente.
verses.en_web: The families of the Gershonites shall encamp behind the tabernacle westward.
verses.en_bbe: The tents of the Gershonites are to be placed at the back of the House, to the west.

verses.en: And the chief of the house of the father of the Gershonites shall be Eliasaph the son of Lael.
verses.pt: E o prícipe da casa paterna dos gersonitas será Eliasafe, filho de Lael.
verses.en_web: The prince of the fathers’ house of the Gershonites shall be Eliasaph the son of Lael.
verses.en_bbe: The chief of the Gershonites is Eliasaph, the son of Lael.

verses.en: And the charge of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation shall be the tabernacle, and the tent, the covering thereof, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,
verses.pt: E os filhos de Gérson terão a seu cargo na tenda da revelação o tabernáculo e a tenda, a sua coberta e o reposteiro da porta da tenda da revelação,
verses.en_web: The duty of the sons of Gershon in the Tent of Meeting shall be the tabernacle, and the tent, its covering, and the screen for the door of the Tent of Meeting,
verses.en_bbe: In the Tent of meeting, the Gershonites are to have the care of the House, and the Tent with its cover, and the veil for the door of the Tent of meeting,

verses.en: And the hangings of the court, and the curtain for the door of the court, which is by the tabernacle, and by the altar round about, and the cords of it for all the service thereof.
verses.pt: e as cortinas do átrio, e o reposteiro da porta do átrio, que está junto ao tabernáculo e junto ao altar, em redor, como também as suas cordas para todo o seu serviço.
verses.en_web: and the hangings of the court, and the screen for the door of the court, which is by the tabernacle, and around the altar, and its cords for all of its service.
verses.en_bbe: And the hangings for the open space round the House and the altar, and the curtain for its doorway, and all the cords needed for its use.

verses.en: And of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, and the family of the Izeharites, and the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites: these are the families of the Kohathites.
verses.pt: De Coate era a familia dos anramitas, e a familia dos izaritas, e a familia dos hebronitas, e a família dos uzielitas; são estas as famílias dos coatitas.
verses.en_web: Of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, and the family of the Izharites, and the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites: these are the families of the Kohathites.
verses.en_bbe: From Kohath come the Amramites and the Izharites and the Hebronites and the Uzzielites; these are the families of the Kohathites.

verses.en: In the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were eight thousand and six hundred, keeping the charge of the sanctuary.
verses.pt: Segundo o número de todos os homens da idade de um mês para cima, eram oito mil e seiscentos os que tinham a seu cargo o santuário.
verses.en_web: According to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, there were eight thousand six hundred, keeping the requirements of the sanctuary.
verses.en_bbe: Those who were numbered of them, the males from one month old and over, were eight thousand, six hundred, who were responsible for the care of the holy place.

verses.en: The families of the sons of Kohath shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle southward.
verses.pt: As famílias dos filhos de Coate acampar-se-ão ao lado do tabernáculo para a banda do sul.
verses.en_web: The families of the sons of Kohath shall encamp on the south side of the tabernacle.
verses.en_bbe: The tents of the Kohathites are to be placed on the south side of the House.

verses.en: And the chief of the house of the father of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.
verses.pt: E o príncipe da casa paterna das familias dos coatitas será Elizafã, filho de Uziel.
verses.en_web: The prince of the fathers’ house of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.
verses.en_bbe: Their chief is Elizaphan, the son of Uzziel.

verses.en: And their charge shall be the ark, and the table, and the candlestick, and the altars, and the vessels of the sanctuary wherewith they minister, and the hanging, and all the service thereof.
verses.pt: Eles terão a seu cargo a arca e a mesa, o candelabro, os altares e os utensílios do santuário com que ministram, e o reposteiro com todo o seu serviço.
verses.en_web: Their duty shall be the ark, the table, the lamp stand, the altars, the vessels of the sanctuary with which they minister, and the screen, and all its service.
verses.en_bbe: In their care are the ark, and the table, and the lights, and the altars, and all the vessels used in the holy place, and the veil, and all they are used for.

verses.en: And Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be chief over the chief of the Levites, and have the oversight of them that keep the charge of the sanctuary.
verses.pt: E o príncipe dos príncipes de Levi será Eleazar, filho de Arão, o sacerdote; ele terá a superintendência dos que têm a seu cargo o santuário.
verses.en_web: Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be prince of the princes of the Levites, with the oversight of those who keep the requirements of the sanctuary.
verses.en_bbe: Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, will be head over all the Levites and overseer of those responsible for the care of the holy place.

verses.en: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites, and the family of the Mushites: these are the families of Merari.
verses.pt: De Merári era a família dos malitas e a família dos musitas; são estas as famílias de Merári.
verses.en_web: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites, and the family of the Mushites. These are the families of Merari.
verses.en_bbe: From Merari come the Mahlites and the Mushites; these are the families of Merari.

verses.en: And those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were six thousand and two hundred.
verses.pt: Os que deles foram contados, segundo o número de todos os homens de um mês para cima, eram seis mil e duzentos.
verses.en_web: Those who were counted of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were six thousand two hundred.
verses.en_bbe: Those who were numbered of them, the males of a month old and over, were six thousand, two hundred.

verses.en: And the chief of the house of the father of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail: these shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle northward.
verses.pt: E o príncipe da casa paterna das famílias de Merári será Zuriel, filho de Abiail; eles se acamparão ao lado do tabernáculo, para a banda do norte.
verses.en_web: The prince of the fathers’ house of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail. They shall encamp on the north side of the tabernacle.
verses.en_bbe: The chief of the families of Merari was Zuriel, the son of Abihail: their tents are to be placed on the north side of the House.

verses.en: And under the custody and charge of the sons of Merari shall be the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and the sockets thereof, and all the vessels thereof, and all that serveth thereto,
verses.pt: Por designação os filhos de Merári terão a seu cargo as armações do tabernáculo e os seus travessões, as suas colunas e as suas bases, e todos os seus pertences, com todo o seu serviço,
verses.en_web: The appointed duty of the sons of Merari shall be the tabernacle’s boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets, all its instruments, all its service,
verses.en_bbe: And in their care are to be all the boards of the Tent, with their rods and pillars and bases, and all the instruments, and all they are used for,

verses.en: And the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords.
verses.pt: e as colunas do átrio em redor e as suas bases, as suas estacas e as suas cordas.
verses.en_web: the pillars of the court around it, their sockets, their pins, and their cords.
verses.en_bbe: And the pillars of the open space round it, with their bases and nails and cords.

verses.en: But those that encamp before the tabernacle toward the east, even before the tabernacle of the congregation eastward, shall be Moses, and Aaron and his sons, keeping the charge of the sanctuary for the charge of the children of Israel; and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
verses.pt: Diante do tabernáculo, para a banda do oriente, diante da tenda da revelação, acampar-se-ão Moisés, e Arão com seus filhos, que terão a seu cargo o santuário, para zelarem pelo cumprimento dos deveres dos filhos de Israel; e o estranho que se chegar será morto.
verses.en_web: Those who encamp before the tabernacle eastward, in front of the Tent of Meeting toward the sunrise, shall be Moses, and Aaron and his sons, keeping the requirements of the sanctuary for the duty of the children of Israel. The stranger who comes near shall be put to death.
verses.en_bbe: And those whose tents are to be placed on the east side of the House in front of the Tent of meeting, looking to the dawn, are Moses and Aaron and his sons, who will do the work of the holy place for the children of Israel; and any strange person who comes near will be put to death.

verses.en: All that were numbered of the Levites, which Moses and Aaron numbered at the commandment of the LORD, throughout their families, all the males from a month old and upward, were twenty and two thousand.
verses.pt: Todos os que foram contados dos levitas, que Moisés e Arão contaram por mandado do Senhor, segundo as suas famílias, todos os homens de um mês para cima, eram vinte e dois mil.
verses.en_web: All who were counted of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron counted at the commandment of Yahweh, by their families, all the males from a month old and upward, were twenty-two thousand.
verses.en_bbe: All the Levites numbered by Moses and Aaron at the order of the Lord, all the males of one month old and over numbered in the order of their families, were twenty-two thousand.

verses.en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Number all the firstborn of the males of the children of Israel from a month old and upward, and take the number of their names.
verses.pt: Disse mais o Senhor a Moisés: Conta todos os primogênitos dos filhos de Israel, da idade de um mês para cima, e toma o número dos seus nomes.
verses.en_web: Yahweh said to Moses, “Count all the firstborn males of the children of Israel from a month old and upward, and take the number of their names.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses, Let all the first male children be numbered, and take the number of their names.

verses.en: And thou shalt take the Levites for me (I am the LORD) instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel; and the cattle of the Levites instead of all the firstlings among the cattle of the children of Israel.
verses.pt: E para mim tomarás os levitas (eu sou o Senhor) em lugar de todos os primogênitos dos filhos de Israel, e o gado dos levitas em lugar de todos os primogênitos entre o gado de Israel.
verses.en_web: You shall take the Levites for me (I am Yahweh) instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel; and the livestock of the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the livestock of the children of Israel.”
verses.en_bbe: And give to me the Levites (I am the Lord) in place of the first sons of the children of Israel; and the cattle of the Levites in place of the first births among the cattle of the children of Israel.

verses.en: And Moses numbered, as the LORD commanded him, all the firstborn among the children of Israel.
verses.pt: Moisés, pois, contou, como o Senhor lhe ordenara, todos os primogênitos entre os filhos de Israel.
verses.en_web: Moses counted, as Yahweh commanded him, all the firstborn among the children of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: So Moses had all the first sons among the children of Israel numbered, as the Lord said to him.

verses.en: And all the firstborn males by the number of names, from a month old and upward, of those that were numbered of them, were twenty and two thousand two hundred and threescore and thirteen.
verses.pt: E todos os primogênitos, pelo número dos nomes, da idade de um mês para cima, segundo os que foram contados deles, eram vinte e dois mil duzentos e setenta e três.
verses.en_web: All the firstborn males according to the number of names, from a month old and upward, of those who were counted of them, were twenty-two thousand two hundred seventy-three.
verses.en_bbe: Every first son from a month old and over was numbered by name, and the number came to twenty-two thousand, two hundred and seventy-three.

verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.pt: Disse ainda mais o Senhor a Moisés:
verses.en_web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said to Moses,

verses.en: Take the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, and the cattle of the Levites instead of their cattle; and the Levites shall be mine: I am the LORD.
verses.pt: Toma os levitas em lugar de todos os primogênitos entre os filhos de Israel, e o gado dos levitas em lugar do gado deles; porquanto os levitas serão meus. Eu sou o Senhor.
verses.en_web: “Take the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites instead of their livestock; and the Levites shall be mine. I am Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: Take the Levites in place of all the first sons of the children of Israel, and the cattle of the Levites in place of their cattle; the Levites are to be mine; I am the Lord.

verses.en: And for those that are to be redeemed of the two hundred and threescore and thirteen of the firstborn of the children of Israel, which are more than the Levites;
verses.pt: Pela redenção dos duzentos e setenta e três primogênitos dos filhos de Israel, que excedem o número dos levitas,
verses.en_web: For the redemption of the two hundred seventy-three of the firstborn of the children of Israel, who exceed the number of the Levites,
verses.en_bbe: And the price you have to give for the two hundred and seventy-three first sons of the children of Israel which are in addition to the number of the Levites,

verses.en: Thou shalt even take five shekels apiece by the poll, after the shekel of the sanctuary shalt thou take them: (the shekel is twenty gerahs:)
verses.pt: receberás por cabeça cinco siclos; conforme o siclo do santuário os receberás (o siclo tem vinte jeiras),
verses.en_web: you shall take five shekels apiece for each one; after the shekel of the sanctuary you shall take them (the shekel is twenty gerahs):
verses.en_bbe: Will be five shekels for every one, by the scale of the holy place (the shekel is twenty gerahs);

verses.en: And thou shalt give the money, wherewith the odd number of them is to be redeemed, unto Aaron and to his sons.
verses.pt: e darás a Arão e a seus filhos o dinheiro da redenção dos que excedem o número entre eles.
verses.en_web: and you shall give the money, with which their remainder is redeemed, to Aaron and to his sons.”
verses.en_bbe: And this money, the price of those over the number of the Levites, is to be given to Aaron and his sons.

verses.en: And Moses took the redemption money of them that were over and above them that were redeemed by the Levites:
verses.pt: Então Moisés recebeu o dinheiro da redenção dos que excederam o número dos que foram remidos pelos levitas;
verses.en_web: Moses took the redemption money from those who exceeded the number of those who were redeemed by the Levites;
verses.en_bbe: So Moses took the money, the price of those whose place had not been taken by the Levites;

verses.en: Of the firstborn of the children of Israel took he the money; a thousand three hundred and threescore and five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:
verses.pt: dos primogênitos dos filhos de Israel recebeu o dinheiro, mil trezentos e sessenta e cinco siclos, segundo o siclo do santuário.
verses.en_web: from the firstborn of the children of Israel he took the money, one thousand three hundred sixty-five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:
verses.en_bbe: From the first sons of Israel he took it, a thousand, three hundred and sixty-five shekels, by the scale of the holy place;

verses.en: And Moses gave the money of them that were redeemed unto Aaron and to his sons, according to the word of the LORD, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.pt: E Moisés deu o dinheiro da redenção a Arão e a seus filhos, conforme o Senhor lhe ordenara.
verses.en_web: and Moses gave the redemption money to Aaron and to his sons, according to Yahweh’s word, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
verses.en_bbe: And he gave the money to Aaron and his sons, as the Lord had said.
